local_changes: src/platform/macos.rs: native utun boundary via Swift helper
src/runtime.rs: enable cancellable macOS interface setup, retain a congested frame in FIFO order, bounded 256-frame Darwin peer queues and split drop accounting
src/peer.rs and src/udp.rs: reserve two UDP commands for control; regression-test congestion without advancing the cipher chain
src/session.rs: Darwin blocking-read contract, poll readiness and contextual authentication errors
src/udp.rs: portable connected-UDP tests, Darwin local-delivery synchronization and poll readiness
src/wake.rs: pollable local notifications on macOS instead of ignoring network/interface readiness
src/peer.rs: physical-interface test address when a transparent proxy owns the default route
